name: TypeSafe AI
description: Structured evaluation with Jev (TypeSafe AI System One) — through TypeSafe's own API or OpenRouter.
systemPrompt: Use finch_jev_evaluate whenever a request reduces to a judgment over natural-language text — classification, routing, scoring, yes/no detection, verification or field extraction — and the answer should come back as calibrated probabilities and confidence instead of prose. Report the answers, probabilities and confidence exactly as returned; never invent values the API did not return.
